payout_quote: 262138 - QPS Missouri. This clinical research study will be evaluating an investigation vaccine in healthy adults. Are You a Good Fit? Men and/or Women, Between 18 and 64 years of age, Body Mass Index (BMI) between 18 and 32 kg/m2. Receive up to $4,325 for your participation in this study. This study will consist of multiple outpatient return visits. Group 1: 8 outpatient visits (Oct 13 - Nov 10, 2026) + follow-up phone call Nov 24, 2026. How Much: $4,325.
steps: Open the QPS Missouri study page (Study #262138, an investigational vaccine study).
Check eligibility (men/women 18-64, BMI 18-32) and submit the application online or call 417-831-2048.
Pass screening and join a study group.
Complete the schedule: the 8 outpatient return visits plus the follow-up phone call.
Receive up to $4,325 for participation in the study.
catches: You must qualify (healthy adults 18-64, BMI 18-32) and pass screening — not everyone qualifies.
The $4,325 is an 'up to' ceiling; the per-group breakdown shows the full amount is tied to completing all visits.
Time commitment: 8 clinic visits spread over roughly a month plus a follow-up call (dates Oct-Nov 2026).
This is a study of an investigational vaccine — real medical risks disclosed in the consent process.
Study dates are tentative and subject to change; the listing says dates are updated weekly.

timing: Compensation paid for participation in the study.
